crumbs.name: Knowledge Based Professions and their Future

sections.body: Finding acquisition targets in private equity and deal sourcing means using AI to identify, screen, and rank companies that fit a fund's investment thesis. The work covers private and public targets, from initial universe building through preliminary due diligence. The site's 432 company pages and 352 merger and acquisition filings give a structured base for comparing candidates. This is not about executing the deal but about narrowing a large market into a shortlist.
sections.heading: Scope

sections.body: AI deal sourcing typically runs on cloud data warehouses or data platforms that combine structured financial data, news, web traffic, job postings, and ownership records. Models are served through internal tools or third-party screening platforms, often with APIs that pull from curated company and filing data. Compute needs are modest compared to large language model training, mostly batch scoring and retrieval.
sections.heading: What it runs on

sections.body: Practitioners build a target profile from criteria like sector, revenue, growth, margin, technology stack, and management quality. They then use entity resolution to match companies across sources, natural language processing to read filings and news, and predictive models to score fit and likelihood of sale. The output is a ranked list with reasons, which analysts review before outreach. The site's 352 merger and acquisition filings can be used as training labels for what deals actually closed.
sections.heading: How the work is done

sections.body: Data used for target screening often includes personal information about founders and employees, so access should be limited and compliant with privacy law. Models can inherit bias from historical deal data, for example favoring certain geographies or founder backgrounds, and that bias can narrow the pipeline unfairly. Provenance matters because a score is only as good as the source data, and stale or scraped data can mislead. No part of this process is legal or investment advice; it is a screening aid.
sections.heading: Rights, risk and provenance

sections.body: The direction is toward more continuous, event-driven sourcing, where models flag companies when they hit triggers like new patents, management changes, or revenue milestones. Generative AI is being used to draft initial theses and summarize due diligence, but human judgment remains central for relationship-driven deals. Over time, private equity firms may maintain live maps of acquisition targets that update as new filings and company pages appear.
